final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina NovaSeq 6000), STAR + DESeq2 per GEO data_processing
final.primary_estimand: For this series: effect of adenoviral Arrdc2 overexpression vs GFP-only control on the C2C12 myotube transcriptome 48 h post-transfection (cell culture, no exercise).
planned_contrasts: Arrdc2 vs GFP in C2C12 myotubes (abstract: transcriptome shifted toward atrophy; no DEG count given in abstract)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Abstract only (no full text available). checks: 10 samples, C2C12, GFP vs Arrdc2 transfection, matching the abstract's RNA-seq experiment

alignment.stop_reason: No exercise contrast exists in this series (Arrdc2 vs GFP adenoviral overexpression in C2C12 myotubes, cell culture). In addition, the matrix column labels (GFP3-GFP7, Arrdc2-6/7/9/10/11) cannot be mapped by name to the GSM titles (GFP control 1-5, Arrdc2 treatment 1-5); only a positional mapping would work, which is not allowed. The case is refused for the exercise request at the first gate it cannot pass; the design gate would refuse it regardless.
alignment.reasoning: No metadata field equals the matrix column names (inspect alignment_keys empty); the numbers in matrix labels (3-7, 6,7,9,10,11) differ from the title numbers (1-5). Group membership is unambiguous from the label prefix, but sample identity is not. Since the series has no exercise arm, no fact would unblock the requested exercise estimand.

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Abstract: 'mechanical load was increased by ... inducing high-force contractions' in young and aged mice and 'Increasing mechanical load beyond normal ambulatory levels lowered Arrdc2 mRNA, but not Arrdc3 mRNA, in young and aged muscle'. The abstract does not say whether this came from RNA-seq or qPCR; GSE269698 cites PMID 38314723 and holds exactly that design (young/aged, Stim/Non-Stim) plus a DEX factor from the later papers. Only the abstract is available, so the comparison rests on it.

alignment.reasoning: Exact match of matrix columns to metadata 'description' (12/12). Stim from the N/S letter (same as 'contractions protocol' column). Subject = replicate number within age x treatment: the series is a unilateral design (both TAs from each mouse) and the deposited sheet is named 'Paired_YVNvsYVS', so YVN k and YVS k are taken as the same mouse. This pairing is inferred from naming, not stated per sample.

matrix.reasoning: File name 'rlog', values -2.2 to 20.7, non-integer, zeros for unexpressed genes; GEO data_processing says counts were analysed with DESeq2 but no count table was deposited (supplementary only rlog xlsx). rlog is a log2-scale, variance-stabilised matrix, so a log-scale linear model (limma) is the supported route; DESeq2 cannot run on it.
